Boat Capsizes in Bihar's Ganga River, Killing at Least 13 Children

At least 13 children died when a boat capsized in the Ganga River in Bihar's Vaishali district. Rescue teams searched the river for missing passengers. One report stated 14 people, including women and children, were killed. The boat was reportedly overcrowded.
